_about: Puzzle Maker reads Deep Cut's compiled player facts instead of re-pulling the raw sources: Deep Cut already joins nba-player-data, salary-season-finder, nba-career-map, nba-born-died and the aderoa/nba-boxscores game highs, with era team names from the NBA Crossword's franchises file. Pinned by Deep Cut commit and sha256. node scripts/pull-data.mjs downloads exactly these into .cache/sources/.
